device_selection: Mixed application pins registry ID 0000000100000575. SVG uses the system-default Metal device on this verified single-GPU Apple M5 host.
validation: Metal validation enabled for separate regression tests and image probes; MTL_DEBUG_LAYER unset during timing.
driver_source_note: The temporary driver changed only by rustfmt between builds. Its source is removed after validation.

workloads.mixed: Two rounds of eight immediate frames and eight retained frames: initially 256 nodes / 768 draws, 32 opacity-filter leaves, 16 shader-painted draws. Immediate frames replace all paint while preserving topology. Retained phases cover initial render, two whole-content replacements, transforms, removing/reinserting 64 nodes, reordering 16 nodes and resize to 384x224. Each frame completes GPU readback and saves PNG. Paint kinds remain fixed for baseline/current performance equivalence; separate regressions cover kind switching.
workloads.svg: Complete 1730-fixture SVG renderer application, including SVG loading, layout/fonts, native rendering, readback and PNG output. The 32-frame mixed application alone would miss ordinary immediate frames with no native program brush.

order: A/B for even pairs, B/A for odd pairs; identical-current control runs the same current executable for both labels.
timing_scope: Whole-process wall time includes initialization, preparation, GPU completion, readback, PNG writes and teardown; output verification is outside the timer. Mixed per-frame samples include mutation/build through readback and exclude PNG saves. Stage samples from the same process are correlated and descriptive, not isolated GPU timings.
cleanup: Temporary Rust source, timing script, copied application/SVG executables and compiled temporary example files are removed after measurement. No production instrumentation remains.
conclusion: No material regression is detectable in the complete measured application workloads. Mixed immediate/retained median changes 366.204 -> 375.645 ms (+2.58%), compared with +4.00% in the identical-current control. Full SVG median changes 4418.261 -> 4396.405 ms (-0.49%), compared with +0.43% in its control. This is whole-process evidence for these workloads, not isolated GPU/stage speedups or a guarantee for every workload. With ten timed observations per label, nearest-rank p95 is the maximum sample. All 84576 generated PNGs match the validated baseline manifests; 1536 mixed frame samples are retained.
